national_news.title: India and UK Aim to Double Bilateral Trade by 2030 at 16th JETCO Session
bullets: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal addressed the 16th Session of the India-UK Joint Economic and Trade Committee (JETCO) Business Plenary in New Delhi.
The Minister set a target to double India-UK bilateral trade by 2030, leveraging the India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA).
CETA provides zero-duty access for major Indian exports such as pharmaceuticals, smartphones, textiles, and auto components into the UK market.

national_news.title: Centre Directs States to Ensure Transparent Pricing Displays at Clinical Establishments
bullets: Union Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava urged States and UTs to ensure mandatory, prominent display of service charges at clinical establishments.
The measure aims to prevent billing disputes, increase healthcare pricing transparency, and assist patients in making informed treatment decisions.
States were requested to facilitate transparent package pricing for foreign national visitors on Medical and Ayush Visas to boost medical tourism.

national_news.title: Special Voter Enrolment Drive Concludes in Jammu and Kashmir
bullets: A two-day Special Intensive Voter Enrolment Drive was conducted across Jammu and Kashmir on October 10 and 11.
The drive was guided by the Election Commission of India's objective of ensuring 'No Eligible Voter is Left Behind'.
Supervised by the Chief Electoral Officer of J&K, the initiative facilitated new voter registrations, corrections, and grievance redressal through Booth Level Officers (BLOs).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Green Hydrogen Policy 2026 & Greenfield Satellite Townships Initiative
bullets: The Bihar Green Hydrogen Policy 2026 targets an annual production capacity of 1 lakh tonnes within five years, expecting ₹16,000 crore in investment and over 12,000 direct and indirect jobs.
The state government is developing 12 Greenfield Satellite Townships spanning over 3 lakh acres near existing cities, supported by ₹1 lakh crore in long-term financing from HUDCO.
Phase I covers Patna, Sonepur, Gaya, Darbhanga, Purnea, Saharsa, and Munger, while Phase II includes Sitamarhi, Chapra, Muzaffarpur, and Bhagalpur under a land pooling model.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Quashes Chief Minister's Nominations for Medical College Admissions
bullets: The Supreme Court quashed nominations made by the Chief Minister of Bihar for medical college seats, ruling them to be an abuse of power.
The court reiterated that educational admissions must adhere strictly to merit-based criteria under Articles 14, 16, and 32 of the Constitution.
The Government of Bihar was directed to prepare a fresh merit list encompassing all candidates who sought admission, avoiding executive discretion.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Upholds Bihar's Educational Policy for Project Schools
bullets: The Supreme Court upheld the Patna High Court's Full Bench ruling regarding the regularization of teachers in Project Schools established under Bihar's 1981 educational policy.
The court emphasized the Right to Education under Article 21A, highlighting the State's responsibility to provide education in backward areas and promote girls' education.
The State of Bihar was directed to implement the findings within four months to ensure fair and uniform examination of teacher recognition claims.
